subject: zero-budget-channel-planning
seam: src/lib/organic-channels/types.ts:277 (name is length-bounded only - the one descriptive field with no domain)

falsify_precheck: If the channel list came from a closed catalog the finding would not apply to this tree and the technique's procedure step 1 would become its own boundary. The list is open, so the gate has a live seam.

target.name: enrolled link supply flagged for the gate's question

floor.name: curated channels refused outright
floor.note: all 23 still reach the plan and zero were even questioned; three sit on the boundary (aggregators-and-syndication, creator collaboration, cooperate-with-the-businesses-next-door) and none was taken

structural_fact: Three of four descriptive fields in the sole normalizer are constrained to a domain; the field that says what the channel is accepts any 120 characters. An inadmissible channel is therefore filed quietly as partnership, or defaulted to content, rather than rejected.
discrimination: carried by the low-effort conjunct, not the link keyword: of the 23 curated channels exactly three promise links at all, and every one is medium effort
ship_reason: The gate's output is a question; a channel carries no advisory field and the normalizer's only vocabulary is keep-or-drop, which the technique forbids without the arrangement's terms. Rendering an open question beside a channel creates a capability the scope does not name - a direction, not coverage - so it waits for the owner rather than shipping on the standing authorization.
return: a run against the live generator with a grounding that invites an enrolled supply, to measure how often the open door is walked through

subject: brand-voice-capture
seam: src/lib/twin/edit-facts.ts EDIT_BANK_THRESHOLD/isMeaningfulEdit (a 0.25 word-ratio was the only line between a typo and a style correction)
src/components/app/twin/TwinOutbox.tsx and src/components/app/modules/SpeedLeadModule.tsx (both review surfaces bank through it)
falsify_precheck: If replies were short enough that one swapped word clears a quarter, the threshold would already bank voice edits and the finding would not apply. At the product length habit (46-51 word fixtures) one word is 0.02 and the largest single voice edit 0.167, so the seam could only confirm or refute by kind.
measurable: voice corrections banked as style facts over 22 paired before/after fixtures (cs+en replies, 46/51 words): 11 voice, 7 typo/cosmetic, 2 price, 2 rewrite

floor.name: typo+cosmetic+price edits banked; rewrites banked; test:unit; tsc

structural_fact: At 50 words the threshold needs 13 changed words; every voice correction the source names (one adjective, a hedge cut, an added attribution, a sign-off) changes 1-8. The threshold did not filter typos - they never reach it either - it filtered voice.
boundary: a register change spelled like a typo (colloquial elision zvladnem for zvladneme) still reads as a typo; pinned in a test
also: small edits now bank their changed spans with 3 words of context instead of two whole 300-char replies, so the distiller can see a one-word swap
gate: npm run test:unit 4147 tests / 4144 pass / 0 fail; tsc --noEmit clean
return_condition: measure on real sent drafts once the outbox has a month of human edits: share of banked edit facts the next distillation turns into a directive
